digest.component_or_area: code-review criteria routing and threshold governance
propositions: Four LLM code-review criteria (api-compat, deletion-impact, regression, error-handling) must transition from advisory to blocking at calibrated thresholds (0.51, 0.60, 0.54, 0.50 respectively) based on code-v3 sidecar corpus analysis (1760 sidecars, 1173 changes, 4359 findings).
The approved blocking-criterion set expands from 3 members (secret-detection, high-critical-security, security) to exactly 7 members, enforced by governance-pin tests in three test files.
Regression and error-handling are added as new base-reviewer dimension entries in criteria_routing.json with only default_posture, block_threshold, and blocking_enabled consulted by threshold_for.
Three governance test files must be updated to assert the new 7-member blocking set to prevent future unapproved criterion additions.
The calibration must land before RP-06 S1 (dietetic-pompous-boar) captures an immutable CriteriaSnapshot golden baseline to avoid threshold loss or silent drift.
Escaped-bug deep-dive identified secondary workstreams (verifier recall/impact scoring, CI-gate-compat, import-integrity, surface-parity) captured on separate user-approved tickets.
